kypExtensions.summary: Reading the directory mechanistically (receptor antibodies are functional — stimulating/blocking; structural antibodies set the anatomic level — blister plane, basement membrane, subset) and by two-step matching with specificity tiers (ANA screens, dsDNA/Sm confirm, anti-CCP outspecifies RF, antihistone indicts the drug, ANCA patterns split by enzyme target).
kypExtensions.rationale: The source is a flat directory; the target-anatomy frame, the specificity-tier logic, and the contrast-pair organization are KYP's design. Clinical details in the patterns (Nikolsky sign, plasmapheresis, biopsy IF patterns, paraneoplastic SCLC) are labeled extension.
